description: This file is a shell script used for testing git diff whitespace error detection and color output. It sets up various git configurations and attributes, runs tests to verify whitespace and color detection in diffs, tests different configurations of whitespace settings, and checks output consistency and color coding.

methods.name: prepare_output
methods.description: Collects git diff output with color, filters lines with specific color codes into 'error' and 'normal' files.
